activity.title: Founders, Inc. Off Season II just wrapped up and it honestly feels weird typing that. Six weeks ago I showed up to Fort Mason not really knowing what to expect. Now Demo Day’s done and looking back, the thing that mattered most wasn’t the building, it was the people. Made so many new friends through EO , spent time at the The Residency , went to Y Combinator Startup School. Built HeyPCB next to brilliant founders who kept pushing me to think bigger, week after week. I’m just really grateful, these are memories I wouldn’t trade for anything. Back to building HeyPCB . If you’re working on hardware, or know anyone building PCBs, try it out at heypcb.ai and feel free to reach out, would love to hear what you think!

Building what needs to be build. ⚖️ ------------------------------------ • Real-time claim verification against official government data sources • Evidence-based verdicts: Supported, Contradicted, or Inconclusive • Confidence scoring that reflects data coverage and match quality • Direct links to the primary sources used for verification • Browser extension integration for on-page highlight-and-check functionality • API-first design for easy integration into apps, dashboards, and extensions ------------------------------------ https://lnkd.in/gf_CZNyt
